frontmatter.title: Collaborative Student Hub: The Ultimate Zonal Dashboard
frontmatter.description: Imagine a dynamic platform where students collaborate effortlessly, stay updated, and manage their academic lives in one place. This project brings that vision to life with a vibrant Angular-based dashboard integrated with Google Firebase and Bootstrap. Whether you're posting updates, managing events, tackling quizzes, or sharing status updates, this platform is designed for seamless interaction and collaboration. Awarded 2nd place in the Scholar Jet Wayfair competition, this dashboard revolutionizes student engagement with intuitive features and a user-friendly interface.
